title: Development of models and a tool (DBPCytoGenoTOX Predictor) for predicting the cytotoxicity and genotoxicity of disinfection byproducts
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,204-214
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00552C, Paper
M. Y. Liu, H. H. Liu, X. H. Yang
A user-friendly tool named “DBPCytoGenoTOX Predictor” was developed that can be used to fill the data gaps of cytotoxicity and genotoxicity data of DBPs. The 385 high-priority DBPs were identified from an updated DBP inventory with 1816 substances.
